spec.purpose: OIDC trust and approval boundary for governed PROD read/verification workflows
notes: PROD is an approval and identity boundary even when the Lab reuses the shared AKS/ACR physical boundary.
The PROD OIDC principal is read/verification-only; Flux remains the Kubernetes write plane.
Before PR #5 is merged, the design branch may be temporarily allowed only for controlled activation and verification.
After merge, remove the design branch and retain trusted protected branches only.
